items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: I was born on the 400 block on Tarragona Street

ctx.x: Right here in Scola, Florida. I was born on the corner of 7th Avenue and, uh, no I wasn't, I was born on the 400 block on Tarragona Street during the time, uh, when they had that hotel down there for a couple of people years ago.
T-A-R-R-A-G-O-N-I-A. That's the same street, Will?
